# IREAINS–Realtime Engagement Accelerator Insurance


IREAINS is a prescriptive Pega Customer Decision Hub package for insurers. It includes 15 pre-built customer journeys and 77 actions, 45 of them recommended for the minimum lovable product (MLP).

### Overview


IREAINS is a prescriptive Pega Customer Decision Hub package for insurers. It includes 15 pre-built customer journeys and 77 actions, 45 of them recommended for the minimum lovable product (MLP). It covers four business issues: Acquire, Nurture, Retain and Engage. Decisions reach customers through three channels: • the mobile app and web; • WhatsApp, email and push notifications; • the call centre, through Next-Best-Action Advisor. IREAINS adds a decision layer on top of the insurer’s existing systems. Core systems keep transacting; Pega CDH reads what they know, decides the next best action, and hands the customer back to complete it, without ever quoting, binding, underwriting, paying claims or collecting premiums. Arbitration is empathy-first, so service always ranks above sales. Bereavement and claims moments are protected from sales offers. The package runs on Pega Cloud using xCAR Life Insurance data model and 75+ adaptive models all delivered by a 6 member certified team.


### Key Features


- 15 Pre-Built Customer Journeys: onboarding and policy issuance, life insurance cross-sell, premium payment and billing, claims and support, lapse prevention and policy revival, wellness and rewards, loyalty and life-stage moments, SME and group insurance, fraud awareness, customer education, prospect acquisition and call-centre handoff, and more.
- 77 Ready-to-Deploy Actions: organised into the Acquire, Nurture, Retain and Engage business issues, with the top 45 recommended for the MLP.
- Life-Specific Decisioning: – premium-due and grace-period nudges that protect persistency; – lapse alternatives and revival with a health declaration; – cover-adequacy checks based on Human Life Value; – maturity proceeds reinvestment offers; – nominee bereavement support, with sales suppressed while a death claim is open.
- Empathy-First Arbitration: priority order is Service (100), Wellness (90), Retention (85), then Sales (70).
- Three-Channel Activation: inbound through the mobile app and web; outbound through WhatsApp, email and push notifications; agent-assisted through the call centre with Next-Best-Action Advisor.
- 75+ OOTB Adaptive Models: propensity models that learn from every interaction.
- OOTB xCAR Life Insurance Data Model: includes 20 custom properties for a life insurance context, fed by policy administration, new business, claims, billing and CRM systems.
- Fits Your Existing Ecosystem: reads data and events from policy administration, new business (quote and bind), claims, billing, CRM and consent, digital analytics and external data; delivers decisions through a real-time decision API, Next-Best-Action Advisor and the insurer’s own messaging providers; and learns from every response and real outcome (policy issued, premium paid, claim settled).
- Measurable Business Impact: optional control-group measurement against business metrics agreed with the insurer, such as 13th-month persistency and cross-sell conversion, to quantify uplift and guide the expansion roadmap.
- 10–12 Week Go-Live: fixed-scope delivery covering a SAW workshop, two build sprints, UAT and hypercare.
